_about: The 60 gold questions for the BinaSmart banking and money pack (the sector-pack method, design 2026-09-16-airline-travel-design.md section 1.3): 40 Amharic, 20 English, each naming the document under knowledge/banking/ that answers it. `topic` is the English subject the page must discuss, and for a page that is itself in Amharic, `topicAm` is the Amharic one. ops/packs/build-gold.js refuses to write the gold file unless at least three of a topic's content words are in that page's text, so a question can never point at a page that does not talk about it. Questions were written from the pages as they were measured on 2026-09-16, never from memory. Ten of them ask an Amharic question of an Amharic page, which is the first same-language slice in any BinaSmart pack. Seventeen of the sixty were refused on the first run against the fetched pages and were repaired on 2026-09-17: eleven had their label moved to the page that really answers them, six named something no page in the pack answers and were replaced. Every one of the seventeen carries a note saying which, and a replaced question keeps its original wording in question_replaced.

coverage_gaps.subject: published interest rates
coverage_gaps.why: Zemen's rate page is client-rendered and came back thin, so it is not in the pack, and no institution in the pack publishes a lending rate. The only rate figures on disk are deposit rates in Dashen's FAQ and Zemen's business product page.

coverage_gaps.subject: exchange rate board
coverage_gaps.why: No page in the pack carries a buying/selling rate table. Zemen's exchange-rates page was not selected and CBE's is client-rendered.

coverage_gaps.subject: loan calculator
coverage_gaps.why: The word calculator appears in no document in the pack; Zemen's calculator page renders in the browser and came back empty.

coverage_gaps.subject: how to lodge a complaint
coverage_gaps.why: No page tells a customer how to complain. ቅሬታ appears only as a navigation link on zemen-am-home.

coverage_gaps.subject: CBE diaspora accounts
coverage_gaps.why: Only five CBE pages survived the fetch and none of them is about diaspora accounts, so a question naming CBE could not be retargeted.

coverage_gaps.subject: per-question CoopBank FAQ pages
coverage_gaps.why: CoopBank's individual ufaq URLs were not fetched as separate documents; the whole archive arrived as coopbank-ufaqs.

measured.theOneNumberThatMatters: Split the same-language slice and the pack reaches the design target where the language matches. The ten Amharic questions whose gold page is itself Amharic score 90.0% on retrieval and 90.0% as shipped - the 90% the design asked for, met exactly. The twenty English questions on English pages score 80.0% retrieval and 60.0% as shipped. The thirty Amharic questions whose only gold page is English score 30.0% retrieval and 40.0% as shipped. The pack is not bad at Amharic; it is being asked to find English pages with Amharic questions in a corpus where one bank out of six publishes Amharic.
measured.verdict: The target was NOT met and no label was moved to make it look met. Twenty-two of the twenty-seven misses are the retriever returning a different institution's page on the same product, or the same Zemen page in the other language, for a question that names no bank; the gold set can only name one page, so those score zero even though the pack answered. Five are genuine retrieval failures where nothing in the top three answers.
measured.whyAmharicIsWorse: Zemen is the only institution in this pack with an Amharic locale (see sources.json langNote for zemen, dashen, cbe and coopbank). An Amharic question therefore lands on a Zemen Amharic page whatever bank its label names: a zemen-am- page is in the shipped top three for 32 of the 40 Amharic questions when only 10 of them have a zemen-am- gold page, and won rank one in 13 of the 19 Amharic misses. This is not fixable by fetching, because Dashen, CBE and CoopBank do not publish Amharic product pages at all. It is the argument for asking every Ethiopian institution to publish in Amharic, and it is the first time any BinaSmart pack has been able to measure it: 70.0% when the question and its gold page share a language, 40.0% when they do not.
measured.remediesNotApplied: Convention 14 allows four remedies. (a) Retargeting was refused: the plan forbids moving a label to whichever page happened to win, and Task 8 had already moved eleven labels and replaced six questions against the fetched pages. (b) Widening an allow list was refused: every gold page is already in the pack and was verified to contain its answer, so the pack is never missing the answer, and Task 10 is skipped for that reason. (c) The banking PREFER list was measured and left alone: a non-pack document (guide:open-bank-account-ethiopia, guide:telebirr, page:diaspora) is in the shipped top three for 7 of the 27 misses, but the gold page sits at rank 4 in only 3 of them, so removing BinaSmart's own account-opening guide from PREFER could gain at most 3 questions while taking the right answer away from real users. (d) The remaining misses are recorded, here and in the report. The shared reranker, the embedding model, hybridScore and the +0.06 tie-breaker were not touched; the airline gate re-ran at exactly 86.7% retrieval and 83.3% as shipped on the same corpus to prove it.
